article:
> **Key takeaways**
>
> - Ignite describes itself as an SI-native company that provides products, data, experts, evaluation, benchmarks and intelligence as a service. [c1]
> - The company says it delivers this work through three arms: iBuild, iStudios and Ignite Academy. [c2]
> - It lists six services, each offered as a service. [c3]
> - It says it works remotely from Africa so that teams anywhere can work with it. [c4]

## What it does

Ignite lists six services in all, each offered on demand: SI products, data, experts, evaluation, benchmark and intelligence. [c3]

### Training

On training, the company says Ignite Academy develops SI-native experts, with capstone projects and portfolios as part of the programme. [c6]

## Who is behind it

Ignite says it is part of Trustbridge Corp, which provides its ownership, governance and long-term direction. [c5]
dek: Ignite says it offers six on-demand services, from products and data to evaluation, delivered remotely from Africa.
